data.notes: April 2026 was anchored by Coachella season, with Goldenvoice/Framework club programming in Hollywood and major stadium-scale shows around Los Angeles.

events.title: Ye: Live in Los Angeles
events.summary: Ye headlined a one-night Los Angeles-area stadium concert at SoFi Stadium in Inglewood. The Ticketmaster listing confirmed the April 3, 2026 date and 7:00 PM start.

events.title: Freedom LA Japanese Music Festival
events.summary: Freedom LA ran April 3–5, 2026 at The Hangar inside OC Fair & Event Center in Costa Mesa. The official schedule listed MINMI, NAOTO INTI RAYMI, Genki Iwahashi and other Japanese music/culture programming.

events.title: Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival 2026
events.venueName: Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival
events.summary: Coachella’s official lineup page confirmed the 2026 weekends as April 10–12 and April 17–19. The festival lineup was led by Sabrina Carpenter, Justin Bieber and Karol G alongside a broad pop, electronic, hip-hop and global bill.

events.title: 7 Days of Framework: Adam Beyer
events.summary: Sound Nightclub’s official event page confirmed Adam Beyer for Friday, April 10 as part of 7 Days of Framework. Tara Brooks was also listed on the bill.

events.title: Goldenvoice Surf Club 2026
events.summary: Goldenvoice Surf Club returned to Palm Springs Surf Club across Coachella weekends, April 11–12 and April 18–19. The daytime electronic pool-and-surf series featured festival DJs in the amphitheater alongside resort-style pool programming.

events.title: Joost Klein
events.summary: Ticketmaster confirmed Joost Klein at The Fonda Theatre on Wednesday, April 15, 2026 at 8:00 PM. The show was part of the Coachella-adjacent Goldenvoice Presents April run in Los Angeles.

events.title: Noga Erez
events.summary: Noga Erez’s official Atlantic Records press release listed a sold-out April 15, 2026 show at El Rey in Los Angeles. The date supported her 2026 live schedule around Coachella season.

events.title: Goldenvoice + Framework Present Prospa & Riordan
events.summary: AXS confirmed Prospa & Riordan at Sound Nightclub on Wednesday, April 15, 2026 at 10:00 PM. The listing identified Goldenvoice + Framework as presenters for the 21+ event.

events.title: TOMORA
events.summary: AXS confirmed TOMORA at El Rey Theatre on Thursday, April 16, 2026 at 8:00 PM. KCRW described TOMORA as the collaboration between Tom Rowlands of The Chemical Brothers and AURORA.

events.title: Dimension
events.summary: Bandsintown confirmed Dimension at Sound Nightclub on April 16, 2026 at 10:00 PM PDT. The listing placed the UK drum-and-bass/electronic artist at the Hollywood club during Goldenvoice’s April week.

events.title: Joezi and Bun Xapa
events.summary: Songkick confirmed Joezi and Bun Xapa at Sound Nightclub on Saturday, April 18, 2026, with doors at 10:00 PM. The booking brought afro-house and melodic club sounds to Hollywood during Coachella weekend two.

events.title: Stagecoach Festival 2026
events.summary: Goldenvoice’s festival page confirmed Stagecoach for April 24–26, 2026 at the same Indio desert grounds as Coachella. The country-focused festival was led by Cody Johnson, Lainey Wilson and Post Malone, with additional crossover acts across the weekend.
